hint: Pick a status for each prayer: congregation, alone, made up or missed. Tap it again to clear.
deductAsk: You logged {prayer} as made up. Deduct it from your qada counter?
hadith: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If there was a river at the door of one of you in which he bathed five times a day, would any dirt remain on him?" They said: "No dirt would remain." He said: "That is like the five prayers: through them Allah wipes away sins."
hadithSource: Agreed upon (Bukhari and Muslim), narrated by Abu Hurayrah
qadaTotal: Total prayers left to make up
qadaHint: Record how many old missed prayers you owe and reduce the count each time you make one up. Most jurists hold that missed prayers must be made up, along with repentance, seeking forgiveness and extra voluntary prayers.
